svg.aria-label: How sage-bot works, in three rows across Discord, sage-bot (the bridge on the owner's Mac) and sage. 1, a read ask: a mention such as @sage-bot board goes to the bridge, which checks the role and the hourly limit and reads sage's logbook, read only; the answer goes into a new thread. 2, a team vote: sage marks a question, the bridge posts a card, the team presses, and only the chosen option goes back to sage. 3, a lead's talk: the bridge records it in the lead log and #sage-audit; a lead session with sage is not built yet (T159). No Discord text reaches sage as an instruction. Discord is a trademark of Discord Inc. sage-bot is not affiliated with Discord.
